newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Tadiran Telecom rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Tadiran Telecom rated buy.

text.p: Carnegie Emerging Markets initiated coverage of Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd with a buy recommendation saying the shares were undervalued.

"We believe that the shares of Tadiran Telecom are currently exceptionally cheap and that the market is taking an extremely short-term view on the future prospects for the company rather than focusing upon the benefits that the shifting emphasis of the business away from the domestic market will have on 1998 profitability and beyond," analyst Stephen Levey said in a report released on Wednesday.

Carnegie estimated the Israeli company's earnings per share (EPS) will decline 12.6 percent in 1997 to $1.52 from $1.74 in 1996. But in 1998 EPS will improve sharply to $1.92 as the benefit from the shift towards exports starts to impact positively, Carnegie said.
"In 1997 we anticipate sales growth of only 3.5 percent but this masks a big shift in the composition of Tadiran Telecom's revenues," the report said.

By the end of 1998 sales to government-controlled Bezeq Israel Telecom will make up only 21.6 percent of revenues against 46.4 percent in 1996 while exports will grow from 37 percent to 64.6 percent, Carnegie predicted.
With the shares at $21, they are trading at a multiple of 13.8 times 1997 earnings and a 1998 multiple of 10.9.
Tadiran Telecom is a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd .
